== Biography ==

Seven is one of the three gardeners painting white roses red in the Queen's garden. When accidentally jostled and confronted about it, Seven responds by telling '''Five''', "Always lay the blame on others!" Upon seeing '''Alice''' watch them work, Seven cuts short a complaint about the injustice of their task and bows respectfully.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — ally. Seven's respectful bow suggests he recognizes her significance.

'''[[Five]]''' — acquaintance. A fellow gardener with whom Seven interacts.

'''[[Two]]''' — acquaintance. A fellow gardener whom Seven dismisses when questioned.

'''[[Queen]]''' — enemy. Seven appears to fear the Queen's judgment regarding their work.
